cases.detail: Icarus 13.0 rejects an increment or decrement used as a value of a vector narrower than int, an array element or a packed structure member ("sorry: ++ operation is not yet supported on vector slice."), does not support queues and associative arrays in classes, and aborts on ++ of a class property in an expression ("draw_unary_inc_dec: Assertion `0' failed"). IEEE 1800-2023 11.4.2 allows the operators on any integral or real variable; Verilator 5.052 and xezim 0.11.3 pass both cases.

cases.detail: Icarus 13.0 evaluates the right operand of -> when the left one is false, so (i == 0) -> (j++ > 0) increments j. IEEE 1800-2023 11.4.7 does not evaluate the second operand of -> when the first one is logically false; xezim 0.11.3 shares the error and Verilator 5.052 rejects the operator there.
